summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (where weights are hosted and distributed) and developer-facing inference platforms (where those models are served via APIs). Hugging Face dominates as the central hub, crossing 3 million public models by August 2026, though downloads are highly concentrated—roughly the top 200 models account for ~half of all downloads—and China-origin models have surpassed U.S. ones in monthly download volume. Inference platforms like Ollama (local), Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow layer serverless or self-hosted inference on top of open weights, competing on price, latency, and model breadth.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository for machine learning models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and partner-provider inference routing.
platforms.model_count: 3M+ public models (crossed 3,011,630 in mid-August 2026, ~747K added in 2026 YTD)
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public/most private repos; Pro ($9/mo); Enterprise Hub (~$20/user/mo); inference billed per-token/per-second via Inference Providers with pay-as-you-go credits
features: Largest model and dataset hub with Git-based versioning
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Inference Providers routing (Together, Fireworks, Replicate, SambaNova, etc.)
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and teams needing the broadest selection of open models/datasets and flexible hosting

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running open LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple CLI and local REST API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated/quantized models in its library (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.); can import any GGUF
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees (you supply the hardware)
features: One-command local model download and run
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users wanting fast, free, offline local inference and prototyping

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and share open models via API, with easy deployment of custom models using Cog containers.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (LLMs, image, video, audio)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing) or per-token/output for some hosted models; no subscription required
features: Run any public model via a single API call
Cog for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting quick API access to multimodal open models without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference and fine-tuning cloud offering fast, low-cost access to a large catalog of open LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token pricing (varies by model size); dedicated GPU endpoints billed hourly; fine-tuning priced separately
features: Broad open-model catalog including large MoE models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open models who want performance plus fine-tuning and dedicated capacity

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A performance-focused inference platform serving open and specialized models with low latency and high throughput.
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning available
platforms.best_for: Latency-sensitive production workloads and teams needing optimized throughput on open models

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong in the China/Asia market) offering fast, cost-efficient access to a wide range of open models, including leading China-origin LLMs.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi/Moonshot, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token pricing, known for competitive/low rates; free tier/credits for some models
features: Strong catalog of top Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi)
Text, image, audio, and video generation
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking affordable inference and access to leading Chinese open models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform running open LLMs on custom LPU hardware for extremely fast token generation.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Mixtral)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token pricing with a free developer tier
features: LPU hardware delivering very high tokens/second
platforms.best_for: Real-time and latency-critical applications (chat, agents, voice) needing maximum inference speed

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API aggregator routing requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models across dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go passthrough pricing per provider plus a small platform fee; prepaid credits
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting one API to flexibly switch between many open and closed models by price/performance
